response.description: DCa/ECa v6 series AMD based confidential virtual machines are now generally available in 11 new regions: Canada Central, Canada East, Norway East, Norway West, Italy North, Germany North, France South, Australia East, West US, West US 3, Germany West Central.This is in addition to the 6 regions announced during launch of these VMs: Korea Central, South Africa North, Switzerland North, UAE North, UK South, West Central US.Learn more.
response.title: Generally Available: AMD v6 confidential VMs in new regions for January 2026
